mismatches: 12 SOA cases: immediate post-ACK A, subsequent UDP A, subsequent TCP A each omitted SOA authority in Rust
nx.aaaa_and_other_types: Both C and Rust retain the previously cached NXDOMAIN for AAAA/TXT/MX/SOA/SRV/CNAME/TYPE65401; no post-ACK upstream queries in all NX cases.

nodata_controls.invalid_scope: TXT NODATA is not cached by this image, with or without SOA. Both implementations timed out under disabled upstream; these original failed runs are preserved.
nodata_controls.old_difference: 8 no-SOA A/AAAA cases: post-ACK SRV TCP C forwards and returns AA NOERROR; Rust reuses the preceding UDP result without AA or an upstream query. One representative is separately reproduced against frozen main in dhcp-nodata-main-control-01.

references: rfc1035.c:1147-1187 removes F_IPV4/F_IPV6/F_RR from NXDOMAIN cache flags
cache.c:1764-1795 DHCP lookup selects only IPv4/CNAME conflicts
rfc1035.c:2391-2415 appends retained SOA even if a later local address answered
